releases.body:
Fix the stale uncommitted dot.

- Refresh settled repositories instead of only loading them once.
- Never overlap requests for the same directory, so an old response cannot restore a stale count.
- Abort a status request after 10 seconds instead of leaving the dot pending forever.

Initial release.

- Adds a dot to OpenCode Desktop 2.3.x session tabs whose repository has uncommitted changes.
- No branch names or counts; clean repositories show nothing.

Install: `opencode plugin add opencode-session-git-badge`
